checks.statement: Use a divider to group related content only when open space cannot provide the grouping; keep it visible but not bold and do not separate every individual item.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Divider guidance.

checks.statement: Use full-width dividers for larger or unrelated content sections, including boundaries between interactive and non-interactive areas; use them sparingly.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Full-width dividers guidance.

checks.statement: Use inset dividers for related items within a section, aligning them with anchoring icons or avatars and keeping the inset equal on both sides by default.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Inset dividers guidance.

checks.statement: When combining full-width and inset dividers, use full-width lines for different content types and inset lines for nested items; repeated-format items may use spacing alone.
checks.condition: When both divider types appear on one screen.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Using dividers both ways on the same screen guidance.

checks.statement: Use vertical dividers to arrange content on larger screens, such as separating text from video or imagery.
checks.condition: When laying out content on a large screen.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Vertical divider guidance.

checks.statement: Use the Outline variant color role for dividers and implement color values through design tokens.
checks.condition: When rendering a Material divider in the configuration described by the source.
checks.notes: The captured color section names the Outline variant role and states that design and implementation color values are token-backed.

sourceHistory.summary: The captured color section names the Outline variant role and states that design and implementation color values are token-backed.

checks.statement: Use a full-width divider at 100% width; inset dividers use 16dp left and 0dp right margins, while middle-inset dividers use 16dp on both sides.
checks.condition: When rendering a Material divider in the configuration described by the source.
checks.notes: Preserves the distinct table rows for full-width, inset, and middle-inset widths.

sourceHistory.summary: Preserves the distinct table rows for full-width, inset, and middle-inset widths.

checks.statement: Use 4dp between a divider and supporting text; where specified, use 8dp right and bottom margins.
checks.condition: When rendering a Material divider in the configuration described by the source.
checks.notes: Carries through supporting-text spacing and both table margin values.

sourceHistory.summary: Carries through supporting-text spacing and both table margin values.

checks.statement: Treat dividers as decorative elements; they have no minimum contrast requirement.
checks.condition: When rendering a Material divider in the configuration described by the source.
checks.notes: The accessibility page states this directly.

sourceHistory.summary: The accessibility page states this directly.
